# Run Product Iteration

Use `product-iteration-plan.schema.json`, `product-iteration-review.schema.json`, and the approved delivery baseline.

1. Set one measurable iteration goal. Commit only current backlog items within available capacity; bind the delivery and solution hashes.
2. Execute the smallest end-to-end slice. Keep discovery work visible and preserve requirement-to-acceptance-to-code-to-test evidence.
3. Record progress and blockers without silently changing scope. A material discovery creates a successor artifact or `REAPPROVAL_REQUIRED` change.
4. Review working behavior against exact acceptance criteria and evidence receipts, not completion claims.
5. Record the retrospective, unfinished work, quality debt, capacity variance, and next improvement.
6. Finish with `product converge` on a clean tracked commit.

An iteration review does not approve release or replace independent security and operational evidence.
